facts.fact: A journal study, citing NITA-U, states that 603 MDAs, local government sites and public service institutions, health facilities and universities among them, had been connected to the National Backbone Infrastructure, against a target of more than 1,300 government offices in 52 districts; it does not say how many of the 603 are local government offices and gives no date, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: National Backbone Infrastructure (NBI/EGI) connections to government sites

facts.fact: The study states that the government network connecting MDAs and local government sites was begun by the Government of Uganda in fiscal year 2006/07 and is established by NITA-U, the public-sector IT agency; no date is given for the present arrangement, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: National Backbone Infrastructure (NBI/EGI) connections to government sites

systems.country_label: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure and e-Government Infrastructure (NBI/EGI)
systems.tiers: target of over 3,156 km across 52 districts and more than 1,300 government offices; 603 MDAs, local government sites and public institutions connected; 61 of 265 sampled public health facilities connected
